g.text: FROM PAGE TO SCREEN / 02B · EVERY MATCHED LDA CHARACTER

text.style: font-size: 27px; font-family: 'DejaVu Serif'; text-anchor: start; fill: #243e3b

g.text: A topic fingerprint for every voice

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: 51 matched characters · eight shared topics · one color scale. Each row sums to 100% in each medium.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: Characters are grouped by provisional story role; those labels never enter the LDA model.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: Within each character, only installments represented in both LDA outputs are included. Averages use modeled word counts.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #66796f

g.text: The 100-word document threshold excludes some sparse voices. Exact profiles and coverage: character_topics.csv and matched_topic_documents.csv.
